name: Miraga
tagline: AI image, video and audio creation with one-time credit packs
description: Miraga is an AI creation tool for individual creators on web, iOS and Android. Users can type a prompt or upload a photo to generate images and short videos, and use the Audio Agent for voice-over, audio translation, podcasts and speech. A Studio workspace is available for planning stories and storyboard panels. Miraga also provides MCP and API keys so agents can generate images, start videos and check credit balance. Pricing is one-time credit packs with no monthly fee or automatic renewal: 150 credits for $2.00, 520 credits for $7.50, 2,100 credits for $30.00, and 4,300 credits for $60.00. New users get free credits on registration (the public site does not state the exact amount). The site says videos have no watermark, including on the free plan.
